errors.evidence: The description of the horizontal axis is incomplete. It states that it shows the years from 2004 to 2019, but omits the two main categories that group these years: "Внос" (Import) and "Износ" (Export).

errors.text_span: Стойностите се представят чрез групирани стълбове за всяка година
errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart, where segments are placed on top of each other. The description incorrectly identifies it as a grouped bar chart, where bars would be placed side-by-side.

errors.text_span: За всяка година стълбовете са групирани един до друг
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. There are two separate sections on the chart, one for import and one for export. Within each section, there is only one stacked bar per year. The bars are not grouped side-by-side for each year.
For the year 2004, the bar for "Износ" (Export) has a height of approximately 4.5, which is outside the stated range of 5-6 million euros.
For the year 2019, the bar for "Внос" (Import) has a height of approximately 17.5, which is outside the stated range of 15-17 million euros.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са структурирани по серии от години
errors.evidence: This phrase is vague and does not clearly explain the chart's structure, which is divided into two distinct groups for import and export.
